item.title: Today was incredible! To co-host the launch of @MarkRober’s SATGUS in front of a live audience was so much fun! Mark my words, one of those kids in the audience today will grow up to walk on the Moon, Mars or beyond because of their experience today. This mission, as seemingly silly as it could seem, has the potential to reach an entire generation in a way that very few things have before. It’s all about helping people find their love of space exploration, no matter where they’re at, and when Mark’s full video comes out from this, it will reach millions and millions of young, impressionable humans around the world! So proud of Mark, his amazing team, and the Everyday Astronaut / @considercosmos crew for nailing today’s livestream! 🙌
